Pakistani Naval Ship Damaged After Collision With Indian Warship

A Pakistani naval vessel, PNS Hunain, sustained damage following a collision with an Indian warship. The Pakistani ship returned to its harbour after the incident. India's Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) summoned Pakistan's top diplomat in New Delhi over the matter. The collision was described by one outlet as an "unprofessional collision."
